brief: A highly readable military tactical-computer dialogue font for Bullets of Fury, a mid-1990s Sega 32X / Neo Geo arcade jet shooter. Militant meets digital. Strong upright squared block capitals, bold two-pixel strokes, subtly clipped 45-degree corners, a few restrained military stencil breaks and small electronic notches. Clean open counters, clear letter spacing. Readable at native 16-pixel UI size for multi-line dialogue; avoid thin wire outlines, decorative gaps through every stroke, rounded sci-fi hairlines, glow, gradients, textures or 3D. Solid bright white glyph ink on transparent background, consistent cap height and baseline, compact moderately condensed proportions. Distinguish I/L/1, O/0, B/8, S/5. Matching plain readable punctuation, digits and lowercase. An aggressive command-terminal face with the clarity of a professionally designed small bitmap font.
note: Tool description claimed10x8; actual128x160 source is8columns x10rows. Verified row-major character identity. Original ink is black alpha; runtime uses white alpha. Two malformed symbols and oversized dollar use the existing authored punctuation.
